record.title: Polish truckers obstruct commercial freight at three Ukrainian frontier approaches
record.scope: Selective blockade of frontier access roads, not sovereign border closure
record.direction: Freight approach access; direction-specific limits not fully reconstructed
record.movement: Commercial road freight; limited vehicles passed
record.exceptions: Humanitarian and military freight continued; not a passenger closure
record.enforcement: Protesters physically restricted approach-road passage to the international crossings; authorities continued border processing for permitted traffic.
record.relationship: Distinct from subsequent 2024 farmers’ blockade and Medyka episodes; not counted as closure of the entire Poland–Ukraine border.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no status extrapolation to 21 October 2026
record.official_rationale: Protesters sought changes to EU–Ukraine haulage access and permit arrangements.
record.context: Protesters sought changes to EU–Ukraine haulage access and permit arrangements.
record.uncertainty: Intermittent at Dorohusk; January actual clearance directly confirmed at Korczowa, while three-post suspension rests on agreement. No all-post continuous duration.
